title: 'one of the most inspiring books I've read in 2026'
summary: Geert Scheipers teaches the Strategy Management module on GUBERNA's Director Effectiveness Programme — GUBERNA is the Belgian institute for board directors — and his participants asked him for a personal reading list. He published eleven books and photographed the stack: Christensen's The Innovator's Dilemma, Rumelt's The Crux, Lafley and Martin's Playing to Win, Grant's Contemporary Strategy Analysis, Simons's Seven Strategy Questions. Incorruptible sits in the middle of the pile, and is the only 2026 title on a list otherwise made of established strategy texts. The line he wrote beside it, thanking the colleague who put it in his hands, is the one above.
blockquote: thanks for one of the most inspiring books I've read in 2026
attribution_title: Professor of Strategy Management & Academic Director, Antwerp Management School
